run_reduce_mean: run reduce_mean to compute the mean of a tensor across multiple GPUs in a distributed setting
test_reduce_mean: test reduce_mean to verify it returns the input tensor unchanged when distributed training is not initialized
review_reduce_mean: review reduce_mean to understand how it uses dist.all_reduce with SUM and divides by world size
summarize_reduce_mean: summarize reduce_mean which clones a tensor and performs distributed all-reduce to get the mean across GPUs
refactor_reduce_mean: refactor reduce_mean to add support for additional reduction operations beyond mean across distributed GPUs
